homes, validates mission-scoped models, renders Markdown + SVG views,
aurora_shared — Shared domain library that implements model
discovery, parsing, validation, rendering, and compact export
Rendered Markdown Documentation — Per-card Markdown files and mission

Rendered View Diagrams — Canonical view outputs emitted under Views/:
DOT sources under Views/source and themed SVG diagrams under Views/.
Compact Agent Export — Single-file compact model export emitted
as AGENT-<MISSION_ID>.jsjson (default location: model home root).
Model Discovery and Loading — Ability to locate Aurora model homes
from a user-provided path and load all card JSON/JSJSON files into
Model Validation — Ability to validate Aurora model invariants
and provide actionable diagnostics before any downstream
Markdown Rendering — Ability to render human-readable Markdown
documentation for every card plus a mission-level executive summary.
View Rendering — Ability to render canonical Aurora views by
generating DOT sources and producing SVG diagrams using a
Compact Agent Export — Ability to write a compact, single-file
snapshot of a mission-scoped model for agent consumption.
Audit Version Bumping — Ability to update card audit trail
versions (patch/minor/major) and append an audit event in a
Registry Backed Tooling — Ability to validate and render
using embedded canonical registries for card definitions,
CLI Command Runner — CLI entrypoint and command dispatcher
rendering, and compact export workflows and reports diagnostics
Model Discovery and Loading — Discovery and parsing layer that
locates model homes (schema-based), loads card files
(JSON/JSJSON) from disk, and builds a searchable AuroraModel
Validation Engine — Validator that checks structural
invariants (duplicate ids, mission presence, link targets,
reachability) plus policy checks (secret asset ownership) and
Rendering Engine — Renderer that produces per-card Markdown
documentation, executive summaries, canonical view DOT sources, and
themed SVG diagrams; also writes compact agent exports.
Embedded Registries — Compile-time canonical registries for
rules), and view definitions (canonical view set) used by
Human Friendly Artifacts from Source of Truth — Avoid manual
diagram maintenance by generating rendered documentation and
agent-friendly exports directly from the authoritative Aurora card
Automated Guardrails for Model Integrity — Provide
deterministic, repeatable validation and canonical registries so
Aurora models remain structurally sound (reachable, internally
consistent, and relationship-matrix compliant) before rendering
Repository File System — Filesystem-backed store that holds
Validate Models — Validate one or more mission-scoped models
(discovered from an input path) and emit diagnostics; fail the
Render Card Markdown — Render per-card Markdown documentation

Render View Diagrams — Render canonical Aurora views by writing DOT

Render All Artifacts — Render both card Markdown and view

Bump Audit Versions — Bump model audit trail versions

Discover and Load Models — Discover model homes from an input path

Embedded Canonical Registries — Provide embedded registries
for card definitions, relationship definitions, and view

Graphviz DOT Renderer — External executable interface for
rendering Graphviz DOT into a layout used to generate themed SVG
CLI Tooling — Provide CLI tooling capable of managing, rendering,
Discover and Load Models — The tooling SHALL discover one or more
Aurora model homes from an input path (file, model-home directory, or
ancestor directory) and load all card files under each model home.
Discovery is schema-based (presence of Aurora.schema.*), supports a
direct child 'aurora/' folder, and bounds directory walking (max
Validate Models and Emit Diagnostics — The tooling SHALL validate
loaded models for core invariants (unique ids, at least one Mission,
valid link targets, reachability from the mission root) and SHALL
Validation SHALL fail the command when errors are present and SHOULD
still surface warnings (e.g., relationship matrix compliance).
Render Card Markdown — The tooling SHALL render per-card Markdown
documentation and a mission executive summary into a user-specified
output directory. Rendered files SHOULD mirror the source card layout
(card-type subfolders) and MUST be produced only after the model
Render View Diagrams — The tooling SHALL render view diagrams (DOT
sources plus SVG output) for the canonical view set. Rendering MUST
use a Graphviz-compatible DOT renderer (default 'dot') and SHOULD
allow overriding the executable via environment configuration
Write Compact Agent Export — The tooling SHALL generate a
single-file compact export suitable for agent consumption
fields (e.g., $schema, audit trail metadata) while preserving the
Bump Model Audit Versions — The CLI SHOULD support bumping model audit
trail versions (patch, minor, major) with deterministic edits to
affected cards and an appended audit history entry. The current
aurora_cli surface exposes bump commands but does not yet implement
Embed Canonical Registries — The tooling SHALL embed canonical
registries for card types, relationship verbs, and view definitions
so validation and rendering can operate deterministically without
depending on external instruction files at runtime.
